headline: The first release.
notes: Version up a sequence in one click — the old copy is archived and the sequence in your timeline is renamed in place, so your open tab never changes
Version up twenty sequences at once by selecting them in the Project panel
Archived copies keep your folder structure instead of being flattened into one pile
Mark the cut a client signed off, with its own bin, colour and `_MASTER` name
Version the `.prproj` file itself, with the target filename shown on the button before you press it
An amber banner when you have opened an old version by mistake, with a jump to the latest
Alt-click any button to see exactly what it would do without doing it
A short tour on first run, replayable any time from ☰ → Tips & tour
Bin names, label colours and naming patterns are all yours to change
The panel tells you when a new version is out, and never nags about one you have waved away
